title: Counterintelligence/Human Source Intelligence Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL
raw_text:
3. MOS 0204, Counterintelligence/Human Source Intelligence Officer (I)
(LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL

    a. Summary. CI/HUMINT Officers serve in both counterintelligence and
human intelligence billets. They command and/or lead CI/HUMINT units in
tactical information gathering operations and activities in support of
identified collection requirements. CI/HUMINT Officers command, plan, and
direct the employment and execution of CI/HUMINT units and approved HUMINT
operations, and CI and sensitive activities (SA). CI/HUMINT Officers advise
commanders and staffs on information collection efforts and CI/HUMINT/SA
operations and activities. Through the intelligence officer, they support
the overall intelligence effort of the command. Marines in this MOS may be
assigned to a BIC (within their occupational field) that has been coded with
one or more DoD cyber workforce framework (DCWF) work role codes. Please
reference DoDI 8140.10, DoDM 8140.10, and the MOS roadmap for additional
training and certification requirements associated with these work role
codes.



                                          1-9                        Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must submit to a counterintelligence scope polygraph examination.

        (2) Officers attempting to register for the 0204 training track
outside ELT must be screened and recommended by a panel at DCI IID, HQMC.

        (3) Security requirement: must meet sensitive compartmented
information (SCI) eligibility guidelines based on a single scope background
investigation (SSBI)/T5 investigation.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Completed the Tactical Intelligence Officer Course (TIOC)
(N46CU22), Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Marine Corps Detachment Dam
Neck, VA.

        (2) Complete the MAGTF Counter Intelligence/Human Intelligence Course
(N46HFW2), Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Marine Corps Detachment Dam
Neck, VA.

        (3) Complete the MAGTF Counter Intelligence/Human Intelligence
Officer Course (CIHIOC) (N460JN2), Marine Corps Detachment, Dam Neck, VA.

        (4) Upon completion of this course, Marine Corps Detachment Dam Neck
personnel will assign PMOS 0202 and this NMOS to the Marine.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (g), Intelligence Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
